title: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails

entities.name: Lluwen
entities.description: A Lorwyn elf hunter and Witherbloom student who stabs a classmate, finds archaics in a hollow titan and overhears Fel and Jadzi.

entities.name: Professor Fel
entities.description: A Witherbloom professor and planeswalker who is devoted to an oath and argues with Jadzi over using students in his scheme.

entities.name: Oracle Jadzi
entities.description: An oracle who warns Fel about the archaics acting strangely and is carried away by a giant archaic.

entities.name: Ivarin
entities.description: An Arcavian elf student who mocks Lluwen as a goat and ram-clan and is cut by him.

entities.name: Tam
entities.description: A gorgon Quandrix student who shares a tent with Lluwen and freezes before a giant archaic.

entities.name: Abigale
entities.description: An owlin student whose letter mentions a sign-language mistranslation with Kamigawans.

entities.name: Kirol
entities.description: A vampire student who rushes to help Lluwen and Tam after the Code Oona message.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker and Kirol's advisor who offers a compromise before they leave for Titan's Grave.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A professor who is missing; Fel was due to meet with her.

entities.name: Professor Kasmina
entities.description: A former professor whose name is whispered with dread on campus after an incident.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: Lorwyn's faerie queen, whose name inspires the friends' emergency phrase Code Oona.

entities.name: Archaics
entities.description: Giant many-armed beings that chant in coordinated patterns; six gather around a snarl in the hollow titan and many act strangely.

entities.name: Giant archaic
entities.description: A far larger archaic-like creature wreathed in star arches that stands over the camp and carries Jadzi away.

entities.name: Lumarets
entities.description: Small plant-animal creatures Lluwen saw communicating with a map.

entities.name: Titan's Grave
entities.description: The forest in a titan's hollow bones where Witherbloom conducts fieldwork.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university all the students attend.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: Lluwen's home plane.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: Tam's home plane.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: A plane whose people misread some Arcavian signs as rude gestures.

entities.name: Star arches
entities.description: Gravitational anomalies that hover around the giant creature like jewels in a crown.

entities.name: Scribing board
entities.description: Magical boards by which the friends exchange messages, including the Code Oona alarm.

events.summary: Fel quizzes his students on what they hear; Lluwen, stung by yesterday's rebuke, wants to give a right answer.
events.quote: I want to give the right answer

events.summary: Ivarin taunts Lluwen as a goat and ram-clan, and Lluwen retaliates by slashing his chest with a knife.
events.quote: He dragged the knife across Ivarin's chest.

events.summary: Fel pins Lluwen's coat to a tree with a thorn and orders him to control himself or find another home.
events.quote: You will learn to control yourself, or you will learn to find another home,

events.summary: Lluwen realizes the titan's bones are hollow and falls through into the dark.
Lluwen wakes in the titan's hollow to find six archaics gathered around a snarl of magic and chanting.
events.quote: six enormous figures, each with too many limbs undulating in time, sat gathered around a thick snarl of magic—archaics.

events.summary: The archaics notice Lluwen sketching and stop, and he flees up a vine while their chant grows louder.
events.quote: Lluwen didn't need to be told twice.

events.summary: Fel hauls Lluwen out and asks if he has anything to impress him; Lluwen is too afraid to tell him what he saw.
events.quote: I hope you have something to impress me.

events.summary: Tam tells Lluwen that archaics were once oracles and suggests speaking with Jadzi.
events.quote: she told me that all archaics used to be oracles.

events.summary: Lluwen overhears Fel and Jadzi argue over Fel's scheme involving students and an oath he swore.
events.quote: No, I swore an oath of devotion, Jadzi.

events.summary: Jadzi tells Fel that Professor Vess is missing and that another incident after Kasmina's could cause a stir.
events.quote: No one knows where she is,

events.summary: Lluwen decides not to tell Fel about the archaics and returns to his room.
Lluwen admits to Tam that he did not tell Jadzi about the archaics; Tam hugs him.
The ground shakes and a massive creature wreathed in star arches looms over the camp, and Tam freezes.
events.quote: A massive figure blocked the gold of the moon.

events.summary: The giant creature stands and walks away, leaving the camp in chaos.
Fel asks Tam and Lluwen if they have seen Oracle Jadzi, who is missing.
events.quote: His eyes burning, Fel asked the two of them if they had seen Oracle Jadzi.

events.summary: Kirol sees the Code Oona message and sets out to help, but runs into Ajani.
events.quote: When the five of them had come up with the phrase

events.summary: Kirol tells Ajani an archaic carried Jadzi away and Fel is acting strangely; Ajani offers a compromise.
events.quote: Let me speak with the other professors and see what I can learn.

events.summary: Kirol requisitions a horse and leaves before Ajani returns.
events.quote: From atop a requisitioned horse, Kirol grinned back at the camp.

relations.note: Ivarin tormented Lluwen and Lluwen cut him.
relations.quote: He's been tormenting me for weeks .

relations.note: Fel is Lluwen's professor and disciplines him.
relations.quote: Call for a healer. Ivarin will need care.

relations.note: Colleagues who argue yet have tea together.
relations.quote: Only two colleagues having tea together.

relations.note: She shares his tent to keep him company and hugs him.
relations.quote: But Tam had wanted to keep her friend company
nothing worth doing is worth doing alone.

relations.note: Archaics are future oracles seen from the past, per Tam.
A huge archaic carried Jadzi away.
relations.quote: Some kind of huge archaic showed up and carried her away
